tables.title: Summary of device limitations
tables.text_helper: Table 3, "Summary of device limitations", on page 2 of Rev 6 in section 1 (Summary of device errata).

rows: Access permission faults are prioritized over unaligned device memory faults
LSE crystal oscillator may be disturbed by transitions on PC13
Peripheral triggers connected to RTC wakeup timer interrupt instead of RTC wakeup timer trigger signal
Additional consumption on PA11/PA12 in Stop and Standby modes
LSE low drive mode is not functional
Flash memory latency is increased during read-while-write (RWW) operation
Full JTAG configuration without NJTRST pin cannot be used
SRAM2 unduly erased upon a backup domain reset
PLL2 output cannot be used as LPTIM clock source
Clearing IWDG_SW might result in debug authentication failure
Clearing WWDG_SW might result in debug authentication failure
Corrupted content of the backup domain due to a missed power-on reset after this domain supply voltage drop
Read from flash memory may fail in VOS2 and VOS1 range
Debug not available when the PRODUCT_STATE is iROT- Provisioned
Low-speed external clock in analog bypass mode might not work properly
PLL1P output can unduly be disabled by software when used as SYSCLK clock
Invalid DAC output voltage for several DAC kernel clocks
LPTIM2_CH1 might prevent the system from entering low-power modes
Debug authentication fails when embedded firmware changes PRODUCT_STATE
New context conversion initiated without waiting for trigger when writing new context in ADC_JSQR with JQDIS = 0 and JQM = 0
Two consecutive context conversions fail when writing new context in ADC_JSQR just after previous context completion with JQDIS = 0 and JQM = 0
Injected data stored in the wrong ADC_JDRx registers
The Comparator cannot wakeup the device from low power mode in some specific conditions
COMP input PA0 interfering with PB0, PB2, or DAC
Bidirectional break mode not working with short pulses
Device may remain stuck in LPTIM interrupt when entering Stop mode
ARRM and CMPM flags are not set when APB clock is slower than kernel clock
Interrupt status flag is cleared by hardware upon writing its corresponding bit in LPTIM_DIER register
Overcapture stops working when CCxOF flag is cleared in some specific conditions
Independent watchdog does not wake up the system from Stop mode
Alarm flag may be repeatedly set when the core is stopped in debug
Tamper event 15 raised when a system reset occurs
Timestamp flag unexpectedly raised when disabling timestamp
Wrong data sampling when data setup time (tSU;DAT) is shorter than one I2C kernel clock period
Spurious bus error detection in controller mode
SDA held low upon SMBus timeout expiry in target mode
2I3C controller: unexpected read data bytes during a legacy IC read
I3C controller: SCL clock is not stalled during address ACK/NACK phase following a frame start, when enabled through I3C_TIMINGR2 register
I3C controller: unexpected first frame with a 0x7F address when the I3C peripheral is enabled
I3C controller: no timestamp on IBI acknowledge when timing control is used in Asynchronous mode 0
Data corruption due to noisy receive line
USART does not generate DMA requests after setting/clearing DMAT bit
Wrong data received in smartcard mode and 0.5 stop bit configuration
Received data may be corrupted upon clearing the ABREN bit
Noise error flag set while ONEBIT is set
LPUART does not generate DMA requests after setting/clearing DMAT bit
Possible LPUART transmitter issue when using low BRR[15:0] value
RDY output failure at high serial clock frequency
Truncation of SPI output signals after EOT event
TIFRE flag wrongly set in slave PCM long frame mode if FIXCH = 1
TIFRE flag never set in slave PCM/I2S mode if FIXCH = 0
Desynchronization under specific condition with edge filtering enabled
Tx FIFO messages inverted under specific buffer usage and priority setting
Buffer description table update completes after CTR interrupt triggers

tables.title: Document revision history
tables.text_helper: Table 5, "Document revision history", on page 27 of Rev 6.

rows: Added errata: •System: Corrupted content of the backup domain due to a missed power-on reset after this domain supply voltage drop •Read from flash memory may fail in VOS2 and VOS1 range •Debug not available when the PRODUCT_STATE is iROT-Provisioned •SRAM ECC error flags and addresses are updated only if interrupt is enabled (documentation erratum) •Timer: Bidirectional break mode not working with short pulses •USART: Received data may be corrupted upon clearing the ABREN bit •LPUART: Possible LPUART transmitter issue when using low BRR[15:0] value •USB: Buffer description table update complets after CTR interrupt triggers Modified erratum: LSE crystal oscillator may be disturbed by transitions on PC13. Removed errata (unduly included in the previous revision): •Timer: Consecutive compare event missed in specific conditions •Output compare clear not working with external counter reset

Added: •Section 2.11.1 Data corruption due to noisy receive line •Section 2.13.2 Truncation of SPI output signals after EOT event Removed: •Possible corruption of last-received data depending on CRCSIZE setting •COUNTn_RX[9:0] bitfield reporting one byte less if APB frequency is below 12.6 MHz •False wakeup detection for last K-state not terminated by EOP or reset before suspend •ESOF interrupt timing desynchronized after resume signaling •Incorrect CRC16 in the memory buffer

Modified erratum: •LSE crystal oscillator may be disturbed by transitions on PC13 Added errata: •Low-speed external clock in analog bypass mode might not work properly •Incorrect backup domain reset •Incorrect description of HDPx_STRT and HDPx_END default values •PLL1P output can unduly be disabled by software when used as SYSCLK clock •Incorrect description of EXTI line 53 •Invalid DAC output voltage for several DAC kernel clocks •LPTIM2_CH1 might prevent the system from entering low-power modes •Noise error flag set while ONEBIT is set •TIFRE flag wrongly set in slave PCM long frame mode if FIXCH = 1 •TIFRE flag never set in slave PCM/I2S mode if FIXCH = 0 Removed errata not applicable for this product: •Unexpected regular conversion when two consecutive injected conversions are performed in Dual interleaved mode
Added erratum:Debug authentication fails when embedded firmware changes PRODUCT_STATE Modified erratum: Incorrect backup domain reset
Updated erratum Debug authentication fails when embedded firmware changes PRODUCT_STATE.
